title: Untrusted trust material installed across a privilege boundary
preconditions: An untrusted principal can supply or replace certificate material consumed by a more privileged trust-store update
dangerous_transitions: An untrusted principal can supply or replace certificate material consumed by a more privileged trust-store update
sink_semantics: system or application trust-store installation or update
counterevidence: Trust material and its storage are authenticated and inaccessible to the untrusted principal.
An enforced approval or provenance check dominates every trust-store update.
Establish actual platform, privileges, source ownership, and approval behavior; neither root execution, Linux, nor a missing interactive gate may be assumed.
verification_recipe: Trace the language-specific source cue to system or application trust-store installation or update.
Establish attacker control, effective principal, guarding order, and security impact.
Test the stated language-specific counterevidence against source and runtime behavior.
